text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm here because of the support of<n>everyone at the
Hanshin and Kyoto<n>Racecourses.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list: Show everyone what you're made of!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I will! Everyone's waited for me, so<n>I'll run my
heart out in return.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I may be useless... I may cause<n>everyone trouble...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But I can run... So I'll do just that, all<n>the way up to
the finish line!
